summary: Add three read-only session-efficiency commands to scripts/projectctl.py without changing any existing command semantics, validation logic or governance gates: `orient` (one-shot session context: manifest summary, active handoff content, compact ready list, acceptance commands parsed from the AGENTS.md 验收与交付 sh block; structured errors on any missing source), `next --compact` (seven-field task summaries; default output byte-identical to BASE, verified by diff) and `draft-report <id>` (report skeleton to stdout only, tests pre-declared not_run, S review required/pending; never writes files or pre-declares pass).

Actual run: 23 tests OK (~2.4s) = 19 projectctl (15 existing untouched + 4 new: compact field set, orient facts, orient missing-source errors, draft skeleton never-pass) + 4 governance. Verified independently by the S reviewer.

findings: No code blockers. Reviewer confirmed line-by-line: compact does not touch ready-detection; orient is purely read-only with structured errors and no partial-success path; draft-report writes nothing and cannot pre-declare pass; git diff -U0 shows zero modification to existing function bodies (check/_validate_report/verify-change/CRITICAL_PATHS untouched); _ready_tasks extraction is logic-identical to BASE command_next; existing 16 tests untouched.

review.evidence: Reviewer independently ran the 23-test suite, BASE-vs-HEAD byte-identity diffs on clean and live copies, draft-report no-write check, skeleton through _validate_report (only expected summary/tests_no_pass/review-pending issues, zero structural issues), and verified whitelist coverage of all 7 changed files.
